items.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000
items.q: No not really, I didn’t have to tell Cary what to do. No.

ctx.x: Beautiful. Can you recall when you first brought this to the group, how much describing — for instance, that guitar thing. Did you describe to your guitar player I want something kind of ethereal or did you let them try things and guide them?
No not really, I didn’t have to tell Cary what to do. No.
That’s why you have him, right?
